plainText:
Pangoro Poses a Problem (Japanese: ゴロンダ、探る , Search) is the 562nd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 14th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Alexa finishes her report of the Vaniville Town incident.
Alexa learns from Viola what happened in Santalune City.
Alexa heads off to Prism Tower to have an interview with Professor Sycamore.
reveals he decided to keep Marisso and nicknamed Salamè.
Upon arriving, Alexa finds that the Lumiose Press editor-in-chief has already done the interview in her place.
Sensing that something is wrong, X heads into Prism Tower and finds Alexa being attacked by the editor-in-chief.
X rescues Alexa, but the editor-in-chief captures and holds it hostage.
takes Alexa to safety and promises that X will rescue Heli.
Alexa realizes that some force must be controlling the media to make sure the truth about Vaniville Town does not become public knowledge.
